messages:
maya: Quick sync — proposing a 'regression sandwich' test for tomorrow's quant bring-up. Goal: catch statistical drifts and surface subtle semantic regressions before canary.

jin: Sounds good. What's the sandwich composition? short bullet pls.

maya: Top-level plan: 1) Calibration run (fast, small) to check perplexity, logits shift, and timing; 2) Golden-prompts smoke (curated 100 prompts) for human-meaningful fail cases; 3) Full eval harness on sampled set (≈5k) for metrics & gating. Failure criteria -> block canary.

samir: +1. Add token-distribution drift check (KL > 0.03) and a fallback policy: if semantic regressions > 1% => block. Also ensure cost delta calc (tokens/s AND dollars/token). :money_with_wings:

maya: Exactly. For thresholds I'm proposing: numeric thresholds: metric_delta_threshold = 0.025 (2.5%) for core metrics (exact-match/ROUGE/F1 depending on task), BLEU drop >1.5 absolute for translation, and latency p95 increase >15% is a soft-warning (but if >30% block).

tara: Can we include quant ablation in the sandwich? i.e., q4 vs q8 vs fp16 so we can trade accuracy vs latency in one pass. Also add a "per-prompt fail" flag for triage.

maya: Yes. Run both q4_0k and q8 configs. We'll label outputs so triage can group by prompt and failure reason.

maya: Quick harness command to run the smoke stage locally (example):
```bash
# smoke run: golden prompts + calibration
./eval_harness/run.sh --model redw-7b --configs q4_0k,q8_0 --suite suites/golden_100.json \
  --calib-tokens 10000 --out out/smoke_redw7b_$(date +%s).json

# postfilter regressions > threshold
jq '.results[] | select(.delta > 0.025) | {task: .task, prompt_id: .prompt_id, delta: .delta}' out/smoke_*.json
```

jin: Nice. For the calibration step, can we also emit a small summary.csv with fields: model,config,avg_ppl,p95_latency,token_kl,seed? That speeds quick checks.

samir: One more operational note: tag the run in console with rollout_id so console can map metrics -> rollout. Also gate must write an artifact (pass/fail + failing_prompt_ids) to S3 path: s3://redwood-evals/{rollout_id}/gate_summary.json

eval-bot: automated: smoke-run queued on k8s cluster (job id: j-8743). ETA ~12m. Reply here when complete for quick triage.

maya: Owners: maya (coord), jin (harness), tara (quant configs), samir (gate policy + infra hooks). If smoke shows regressions, we do: 1) quick per-prompt triage 2) if >=1% semantic regressions block canary and open rollback PR 3) run extended eval with human raters on failing buckets.

tara: One ask — add a small synthetic perturbation test (prompt paraphrase corpus) to detect brittleness. Even small lexical changes should not change label >5%.

maya: Good call. Add paraphrase_suite as last smoke check.

jin: I'll add the scripts to the harness and the S3 upload. ETA EOD.

eval-bot: automated: smoke-run completed. summary: perc_regressions_total=1.8%, summarization_regressions=2.4%, translation_bleu_drop=0.8, p95_latency +18ms (+12%), top failing prompt ids: [341, 1298, 77]. Artifacts: s3://redwood-evals/rollout-20270323/gate_summary.json :white_check_mark:

maya: Quick read: summarization is above our 2.5% core threshold? it's 2.4% -> below, but close. total 1.8% < 2.5 so gate passes. latency +12% -> below soft warn. Tara/jin please run targeted per-prompt reruns on ids list and open triage doc.

samir: I'll wire the automated canary rollout to only proceed when gate_summary.pass==true and human_review_required==false. If later manual review flags issues we stop.

tara: I'll run q8 ablation now and post diffs.

maya: Thanks all. I'll update onboarding checklist with the regression-sandwich template and thresholds. Follow-up: tag this thread when you have the triage doc. :sparkles:
